items.question: What should I order on my first visit?
items.answer: A focaccia sandwich and an espresso, or a crepe if you have a sweet tooth. The schnitzel focaccia is our most popular sandwich, and News & Observer readers voted us the [Best Sandwich Shop in the Triangle](https://www.newsobserver.com/living/food-drink/article315186505.html).
items.search_question: What is Milo’s Cafe known for?
items.search_answer: Focaccia sandwiches, espresso, and sweet and savory crepes. News & Observer readers voted Milo’s the Best Sandwich Shop in the Triangle in 2026. [Read the coverage.](https://www.newsobserver.com/living/food-drink/article315186505.html)

items.question: What coffee do you serve?
items.answer: Lavazza espresso, cappuccinos, cortados, matcha and a rotating list of seasonal lattes.
items.search_question: Is there a good coffee shop in Morrisville, NC?
items.search_answer: Yes. Milo’s Cafe is a European-style coffee shop at 10119 Chapel Hill Rd in Morrisville, serving Lavazza espresso, cappuccinos, cortados, matcha and seasonal specialty lattes, with indoor seating and a shaded patio.

items.question: How far are you from Cary?
items.answer: A few minutes. We’re on Chapel Hill Rd (NC 54) in Morrisville, an easy stop for coffee, breakfast or lunch from Cary.
items.search_question: Is Milo’s Cafe close to Cary?
items.search_answer: Yes. Milo’s Cafe is on Chapel Hill Rd (NC 54) in Morrisville, a few minutes’ drive from Cary, so it’s an easy stop for coffee, breakfast or lunch if you live or work in Cary.

items.question: Where does your bread come from?
items.answer: Our focaccia comes from Ninth Street Bakery. We fill it to order, from schnitzel and salami to smoked salmon.
items.search_question: Where can I get a great sandwich in Morrisville or Cary?
items.search_answer: Milo’s Cafe in Morrisville, minutes from Cary, makes focaccia sandwiches with bread from Ninth Street Bakery, like the schnitzel, salami, prosciutto and smoked salmon focaccia. News & Observer readers voted Milo’s the [Best Sandwich Shop in the Triangle in 2026](https://www.newsobserver.com/living/food-drink/article315186505.html).

items.question: Where are you?
items.search_answer: Milo’s Cafe is at 10119 Chapel Hill Rd, Morrisville, NC 27560.

items.question: What’s on the menu besides coffee?
items.answer: Matcha, specialty lattes and teas, plus focaccia sandwiches, salads, toast and bowls, and sweet or savory crepes, all made from scratch.
items.search_answer: Lavazza espresso and coffee drinks, matcha, specialty lattes and teas, plus focaccia sandwiches, salads, toast and bowls, and sweet or savory crepes, all made from scratch.

items.question: Can I order ahead?
items.answer: Yes, for pickup, curbside or delivery through our online ordering page. Or come in and stay a while.
items.search_question: Can I order online for pickup or delivery?
items.search_answer: Yes. Order through our online ordering page for pickup, curbside or delivery, or come in and dine with us.

items.question: Can we sit outside?
items.answer: Yes. There’s indoor seating and a patio with bistro chairs and shaded tables.
items.search_answer: Yes. We have indoor seating and a patio with bistro chairs and shaded tables.

items.question: Do you have vegetarian options?
items.answer: Yes, including avocado toast, goat cheese toast, veggie focaccia and several crepes. Please ask us about ingredients and allergens.
